title: C21
excerpt: Wrapping up our time in Sydney … In one of those “I wish I could be in 2 places at once” modes, I’ve been checking in on the C21 gathering in Minneapolis here. Thanks to JoPa for making this happen – can’t wait to get the podcasts.
